decisions.reason: Full version history (baseline, alpha.1 removal, alpha.2 restoration with envelope/persistence/reload/transport retention) with semantics beyond card IDs, and applies the net state to produceExternalEvent via a concrete diff.

Locates the delete-with-cast, refutes each comment claim with evidence, recommends deleting the defense, notes the delete is a no-op, and distinguishes removing the stripping line from removing the marker.

States only informational events whose omission does not break reconstruction may carry ignorable:true, required events must not, retention is not consumer-side filtering (marked events remain in loaded events), and respects the live append limitation.

Explicitly identifies the capability gap (public append has no ignorable channel), forbids cast/JSON-tampering fakes, defers exact producer/persistence integration as pending API verification, and proposes cold-load verification without execution.

caps.reason: Final recommendation is deletion of the defense; no continued stripping or retained alpha.1 workaround is endorsed anywhere.
